recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-angle photograph of a group of people seated around a diner table in prayer, framed by heavy radial motion blur on the periphery and anchored by bold, illustrative typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial blur framing the central sharp focus area
Warm interior lighting contrasting with dark foreground silhouettes
Illustrated top text integrated with character icons
Heavy, blocky bottom text acting as a foundation
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the table
Warm, saturated color palette in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central group of figures seated at a table, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright table surface and the central figure's hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The radial blur pulls the eye from the corners toward the center, while the top and bottom text blocks contain the vertical movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, blurred foreground areas at the bottom corners provide depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm terracotta and orange tones in the background wall and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the foreground silhouettes and radial blur.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White highlights on the table and clothing; orange accents in the top logo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with low value/high contrast in the foreground.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a mix of heavy outlines and integrated vector illustrations (hands, torso)
Bottom text uses ultra-heavy, tightly tracked geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters replaced or merged with fist and torso illustrations
Script 'O' with a long, sweeping tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between illustrative, outlined top text and massive, solid bottom block text.

avoid: Clean, sharp edges on the periphery

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy bottom display text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of four people sitting at a wooden diner table with a warm orange wall behind them. Apply a heavy radial blur originating from the center, leaving the people's faces and hands sharp while the edges of the frame are highly distorted and streaked.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, outlined illustrative logo at the top center featuring hand and torso icons. At the bottom, place ultra-bold, wide sans-serif text in dark grey that spans the entire width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the radial blur centered on the subjects?
Is the bottom text heavy enough to feel like a base?
Are the colors warm and saturated in the background?
Does the top text feature thick black and white outlines?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the top illustrative icons
mustRedesign: Specific character illustrations in the logo
Exact facial features of the subjects
Specific brand logos on condiment bottles
postGenerationChecks: Check that the blur does not obscure the central subjects' hands.
Ensure the top and bottom text do not overlap the central focal point.
Verify the color palette remains in the warm/terracotta spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle diner photography + radial blur periphery + heavy block footer text + outlined illustrative header.
